names: Government Museum and Art Gallery, Chandigarh
mapIdentity.scope: The named OpenStreetMap building way 129784715 sets the whole museum podium, main slab alignment and both attached low projections. The museum and its conservation team describe the standing characteristic eight roof lanterns, southwest colonnade and gallery enclosure.

note: Frozen Terrarium plaza datum and perimeter grade. The conservation team records a 10.7 m internal hall and 2.8 m and 5 m ventilation openings. Roof, lower wings, ground-floor recession and pier geometries are modeled estimates with the primary architectural arrangement retained.
